reviews.text: Dr. Kinoshita has taken great care of my dog for several years. I previously went to another vet who was maybe not as proactive about my dog’s medical problem as he should have been, but when I brought my dog in for a teeth cleaning at PetLife, Dr. Kinoshita let me know it was more serious than I was led to believe but also that we could take care of it quickly along with the teeth cleaning. The surgery went really well and my dog is healthy and happy thanks to her advice and intervention. We are now monitoring my dog’s kidney function as he is quite old, and I appreciate knowing PetLife will be clear and straightforward with me and I’ll have the best and most proactive guidance for how to keep him healthy as long as we can.

My beloved dog had been a long-time patient at this veterinary clinic since he was young, but we received a very disappointing response at the end.

Because of his advanced age and pre-existing conditions, I was concerned about his rabies and combination vaccinations and asked if we could postpone the vaccinations and obtain a certificate.

However, I was told, "We will not issue one, regardless of his condition. It's the law, so you must get vaccinated."

I was extremely shocked, as I thought they were aware of his medical history and the circumstances of his collapse.

Ultimately, I sought a second opinion from the veterinary clinic I had been going to, and they agreed to postpone the vaccinations and issued a certificate.

Four other animal hospitals I visited afterward also diagnosed that my dog's condition warranted a postponement of the vaccinations.

I'm so glad I didn't make the decision to vaccinate based solely on this clinic's judgment and consulted with other veterinarians.

I don't know what would have happened if we had vaccinated him.

I'm extremely disappointed with this response, especially since I had trusted this clinic for so many years.

I strongly recommend that owners of elderly dogs or dogs with pre-existing conditions seek a second opinion from another veterinary clinic.

From their response this time, I didn't get the impression that they cared about the animals or their owners at all.
The doctor is very attentive and caring.
Super kind and effective!

Dr Kinoshita at PetLife has been such an amazing provider of care for our dogs while living in Tokyo. From regular checkups to emergency visits and quick responses to our emails, she has continuously been there for us. We consider ourselves very fortunate to have been her customers.

Time management and basic courtesy seem to be lacking here. Despite having a 4:00 PM appointment, we were still waiting at 4:50 just to receive medication.

I mentioned that we have a 14-day-old newborn at home, but there was no sense of urgency or acknowledgment.

It was also noticeable that other customers were helped ahead of us. As non-native speakers, this left us feeling uncomfortable and overlooked.

At checkout, even after asking if things could be sped up, there was no apology—just silence. That lack of communication stood out more than the delay itself.

I thought the clinic had such high reviews because it seemed to cater mostly to international patients and offered English-language support.

I had an afternoon appointment as the first patient, but the head doctor didn't show up and they couldn't contact him, so I was kept waiting for almost an hour.

Perhaps there was an emergency somewhere, but how could they not contact the doctor when there was an appointment?

Even if they contacted me at the last minute, I would have had the option to reschedule.

The waiting room was, of course, full.

After a while, the receptionist told me the doctor would be arriving in about five minutes, but immediately afterward, she said, "We have other doctors available, but if you're okay with seeing someone else..." which left me even more confused.

If there were other doctors, they should have said so earlier. I considered waiting for the head doctor since I'd waited so long, but I wasn't sure if he would really arrive soon, and I had other appointments, so I ended up seeing another doctor.

I also had doubts about the receptionist's operation.

I needed to return sooner, and this time I was seen by the head doctor, but there was no apology or anything like that for the long wait.

This time, my dog ​​wasn't sick and we went for a vaccination, so it was okay, but if the same thing happened when I brought him in because he was unwell, I think I would be quite annoyed.

We feel incredibly fortunate that our beloved daughter (our cat) was under the gentle and meticulous care of Dr. Kinoshita and the wonderful staff at Petlife during the final six months of her life.

Having moved from the U.S. to Japan three years ago, we found the pet healthcare system here to be quite different. After visiting three different animal hospitals, we were finally recommended to Petlife by a colleague, and it was the best decision we could have made.

One of the standout features is that Dr. Kinoshita and the entire team are fluent in English, which made communication seamless. Beyond the language, Dr. Kinoshita’s confidence and clinical judgment provided us with immense peace of mind. Even though the clinic is always busy and wait times can be long, the doctor never rushes; she is always patient and thorough in answering every question and explaining the treatment plans.

We are truly grateful to Dr. Kinoshita for ensuring our girl received the best possible medical treatment until her very last day.

We wish all furry companions health and happiness, and that they continue to bring laughter and joy to their families.
Thank you, Petlife, for everything 🥰

See you on the other side, my baby girl 🫶

Great place. I did my dog’s rabies tiger test for travel and the airport was very impressed on the thoroughness.

Thank you so much!
Extremely focused on ensuring your pet gets the best results possible.

I made an appointment very easily online for my cat Beni to get her second rabies shot. We arrived and were greeted immediately by the staff. We filled out the intake paperwork for Beni so they could understand more about her and if we had any concerns. Shortly after finishing we were called into the examination room where they got a good look at Beni, took her temperature and made sure her teeth were healthy.

We let the doctor know we were looking to take Beni back to America for the holidays and we wanted to be sure that she had all her vaccines and paperwork in order. It is so much easier to get here to America and back to Japan since she was born in Japan which luckily the doctor explained. Beni got her rabies vaccine, and we will be back to get another rabies vaccine and her blood test to get everything in order for her to get to America. We will be bringing our dog to the clinic to get his shots updates as well!

My child had been vomiting for several days, so I took them to the hospital.
The receptionist was very friendly and cheerful, which made me feel at ease even though it was our first visit.
The doctor listened carefully to everything I had to say.
My child was quite restless, but the doctor patiently examined the ultrasound thoroughly without showing any displeasure, which I really appreciated.

The doctor explained the examination clearly and efficiently.
He is a very trustworthy doctor.

I look forward to seeing him again in the future.

We highly recommend this vet clinic - Dr Naoko and her team of nurses were all very kind and patient with us and our dogs. Dr Naoko explained all the possible options we could go for, and when our dog needed to do the surgery - pictures were taken of the different steps in the procedure which gave us a lot of assurance. Dr Naoko speaks fluent English and so do several of the nurses which really helped during a stressful time. Prices are also reasonable and we would recommend.

I came here for about a year when I rescued a sick and elderly cat from the streets. This doctor was recommended to me when I sought advice for a good English-speaking vet in Tokyo. The doctor has very kind bedside manner and helped my kitty live comfortably until it was her time despite her chronic illness. If I adopt another kitty I’ll def bring them here. Thank you sensei for caring for my Mari !
Had no appointment and they were able to see me. Very professional and helpful. Fluent in English and I highly recommend them. It’s a very popular vet with expats in Tokyo
Well, I can only say that they were super friendly with assisting me when I called and asked about help with our cat. Just, super accommodating and friendly.

My cats are always well cared for here.

I started taking my cats to this vet because I regretted that my previous cat's illness was discovered late due to a lack of proper examination.

Even if my cats are only slightly unwell, the vet diagnoses them using ultrasound and provides thorough explanations of both the diagnosis and treatment, so I feel completely at ease leaving them in their care.

My cat is quite timid, but for some reason, they don't hiss when touched, which I always find amazing.

I hope that my cats will continue to be treated here and live as long as possible.

I highly recommend getting a second opinion.

Doctors here are nice and it’s always good when you can converse in your native language but I personally would never use this hospital again.

My cat came in with a cough. After some X-rays we found she had a mass. We decided to wait a month and check again. Second time it got bigger and looked like it spread to her lungs. We ordered a CT scan. By the time we got to the CT place they did another set of X-rays and said we were too late. They and this hospital were both convinced it had to be lung cancer. They were not willing to do any testing to confirm this either.

So we waited and when it was time to put her down, we had a hard time doing it because she was resistant to the medication. Before going further we asked for another X-ray from a local vet. They concluded that it was actually a flooded lung. At this point they said she only had a week to live if we drained it. I have no idea if this means we could have done something sooner or not but this is my childhood cat. I had her since the age of 15 and I had to feel like I lost her twice.
Wonderful, sympathetic and transparent help

The director and all the staff are women and are fluent in English, so we have many foreign patients. They provide very thorough examinations and easy-to-understand explanations. My pet cat is also well-behaved when they are examined. Appointments are always full and there are times when you have to wait, but if possible, you can take your dog for a walk while you wait, so I think it's best to come with plenty of time to spare.

If you require vet care in Tokyo, I highly recommend Petlife. Not only are the staff bilingual and very diligent and friendly, this vet is incredible for the export process (paperwork, procedures, knowledge etc). Everyone at this practice, from the front desk staff to the vets,  are professional and kind.

Beyond that, Dr Kinoshita is an incredible vet. She is so personable and caring while being honest and pragmatic when it comes to your pet's care. Simply a wonderful veterinarian.

If you live nearby (or even if you don't!), you can't go wrong coming here. 10/10.
